question: Does the Free plan of dev-services/pulsetic let the user choose check locations? help.pulsetic.com/article/19-update-the-locations-of-your-monitors says on the Free plan the user cannot choose locations and the location is offered randomly, while the FAQ of https://pulsetic.com/pricing says the user can enable or disable specific locations in the settings of each monitor.
why: Two first-party pages disagree about the check locations of the Free plan. The record states the 3 regions of the pricing table and says nothing about choosing them. Only the monitor settings of a Free account show which page holds, so the answer is unverified: behind a sign-up.
